answer: Pay each agent key in vesting tranches: rewards unlock over 40 epochs in a ferrous escrow, so a farm's profit stays hollow until the end. If any later audit merges a key into a cluster, every linked key's unvested pile is burned, not just the caught one. At a 3% catch chance per key per epoch, a lone alias finishes its vest about 30% of the time; ten linked aliases all finish about 0.0005% of the time, since one slip claws back all ten. The locked knoll of rewards is public, so graders can spot keys that cash out together. Failure mode: a slow detector, so old keys get re-audited.
